job.title: Machine Learning Engineer
job.pay_full: $216,700 – $303,400 a year base salary, plus equity (restricted stock units)

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with 100,000+ active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. This Machine Learning Engineer builds and runs production machine learning models for ad ranking, bidding and optimization, in a hybrid role based at Reddit's San Francisco offices.
duties: Design, build and deploy industrial-level ML models for ad ranking, bidding and optimization
Own the full ML lifecycle, from research to scalable serving systems and production upkeep
Engineer features from raw, diverse data
Work with product managers, data scientists and engineers to turn business problems into ML solutions
Build monitoring, alerting and automated retraining pipelines
Research new algorithms and contribute to the team's strategy and roadmap
needs: Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering or a related quantitative field
Two years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation
Skills in: PII data handling, Kafka infrastructure, data governance, batch data pipelines, SLOs, graph services, ML models, XGBoost, LLMs and Google Cloud Platform
Any suitable combination of education, training and experience is acceptable
details.benefits: Base pay $216,700 – $303,400 a year, plus equity in restricted stock units (and possibly commission depending on the position offered). Benefits include comprehensive healthcare and income replacement programs, a 401k with employer match, family planning support, gender-affirming care, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off, generous paid parental leave, and global benefit programs from workspace to professional development to caregiving support.
notes: Hybrid from Reddit's San Francisco offices; part-time telecommuting is an option
Apply with a resume and references via the posting or applicationsreview@reddit.com, quoting Req. 1016.298.4
